title: The build record: every project the store kept becomes one ModelBuild, each part filled or unknown with why
request: Collect the data and the knowledge of building models correctly for businesses: one record per model built, its context, data, recipe, cost, result and what a person changed.
plan: Read the newest project, stage, move and walk records of each project from the store's records tier.
Fill ModelBuild v1 with bands only.
Say every part that cannot be filled, and why.

decisions.decision: A build is read from the store's records, never from the live workspace.
decisions.why: The store keeps a deleted project whole; the build of a deleted project is still a build.

decisions.decision: The newest version of a source wins by its capture time.
decisions.why: Later captures are later versions of the same file.

decisions.decision: Context and data are bands (size, rows band, column count), never names or values.

change: dclab_core/service.py (ModelBuild and the other service contracts, dclab-core 0.99.0); dclab_rnd/store/service.py builds() and _latest().

findings.defect: The first draft read walks' times and stage fields from memory.
findings.scenario: people_minutes and the recipe were empty for every build.
findings.cause: Field names guessed: the recipe sits under the data stage's evidence.recipe.choices, the bar under the final stage's evidence.success_bar.
findings.fix: Read the engine's own stage_data and stage_final to name the fields.

findings.defect: The real store holds no project yet.
findings.scenario: builds() on the owner's store gave 0 builds.
findings.fix: The tests build a scratch store; the backfill is a separate step.

findings.scenario: db/project, db/stage_record and db/transition rows were skipped.
findings.cause: Only file sources were mapped; the shaper also nulled a stage row's record as an id field.
findings.fix: Map the three tables; the shaper lifts a stage row's record into its body.

findings.defect: Spend and moves were counted twice after a log was rewritten, and two workspaces' projects with one id merged.
findings.scenario: keep_log keeps a rewritten log whole again; projects keyed by id alone.
findings.fix: Read each source's current chain (its last whole version and later tails); key by (workspace, project).

findings.defect: used was True for every project whose final stage ran.
findings.scenario: outcome.observed is also emitted for the holdout's own read.
findings.fix: Count only outcomes observed in the business or a promotion.

findings.scenario: A workspace without consent to improve entered the service records.
findings.fix: Read only records with improve or train consent; a training set still requires train.

findings.defect: Students were not builds; unfilled parts were not marked unknown.
findings.scenario: data.columns was always None; industry, used and result unmarked.
findings.cause: Only projects were read; the project's data has a columns list, not column_count.
findings.fix: Students from the tutor's card and measurement; every unfilled part in unknown with why.

findings.defect: people_minutes was wall-clock time and problem_kind was the task.
findings.scenario: A walk over two days gave 2880 minutes.
findings.fix: Active minutes with gaps capped at 30; the kind from solution.kind or the data stage; chat turns counted, questions marked unknown.

findings.defect: The service step scanned the store four times.
findings.scenario: write() built the builds in four places.
findings.fix: Build once in write() and pass them down.

outcome: Every kept project is a build record with its parts or why not.
lessons: Name record fields from the code that writes them, never from memory.
Write fixtures from the code that writes the records (a stage record copied from the engine), never from memory: invented shapes made every test pass while every real build was judged wrong.
risks: The code export's rerun is not in the records, so no build is correct until it is.
